addr: Main Rd, 12th Main, 100 Feet Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Doopanahalli, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008, India

rev.t: Had a really good time at Quarter Peter. The first thing I noticed was how energetic the place was—it was packed, and the crowd itself created a great vibe. …

We visited on weekend but no crowd and nice place.
Food was good not much taste okok.
And liquor and food was very costly compering for that place. …

Budget friendly, pocket friendly and great staff. Food is served in small plates which helps us taste all their dishes and explore different cuisines. Also the menu isn’t confusing with too many items on their menu. Best for friends and family.
